description: Perth Metro (Winter 2021) capture dates index is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. The Landgate Perth Metro aerial mosaics cover approx. 9,400sqkm and in the summer, are typically captured over several days - weather permitting. However, flying the same extent in winter months poses many additional challenges including reduced number of flying hours (to avoid long shadows), and interruptions caused by cloud and the smoke from prescribed burns. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are Perth Metro winter 2021, Winter 2021, capture dates, capture dates index, capture index. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2023-09-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Public Domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
